seoTitle: Perspective Corrector (Straighten a Photo of a Page or Building)
metaDescription: Mark the four corners of a document, whiteboard or facade in a photo and warp it into a flat rectangle. Drag the corners or type their positions.
intro: Straighten a skewed photo of a page, whiteboard or building.
why:
Choose a photo and move four numbered corners onto the corners of the flat object. Press Straighten and the picture is warped into a flat rectangle. You can drag the handles or type each corner position in percent, so it works without a pointer.

The output size is worked out from the edge lengths, or you can set it. Sampling is bilinear, and the warp was checked against Pillow's perspective transform.
howTo: Move the four corners onto the object, clockwise from the top left.
Press Straighten and download the PNG.

faq.a: A perspective change is defined by four corner pairs.
It is a flattened picture. For text, a clean scan from a good photo helps.
Output is limited to 5000 pixels per side.
No. The work happens in your browser and the page makes no network request with your input.
